notes.subject: guardduty
notes.text: runs in every region, but the region catalog holds no aws regions (`opsdir prerequisites`): only us-east-1 renders
how: Fetch the region catalog (`opsdir prerequisites`), then re-render
notes.scope: every region of source/prod but us-east-1

notes.subject: audit trail cloudtrail
notes.text: bucket example-aero-ciam-prod-cloudtrail (audit-archive) must let cloudtrail.amazonaws.com s3:GetBucketAcl on arn:aws:s3:::example-aero-ciam-prod-cloudtrail; s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::example-aero-ciam-prod-cloudtrail/AWSLogs/111122223333/* (s3:x-amz-acl bucket-owner-full-control on writes; aws:SourceArn arn:aws:cloudtrail:us-east-1:111122223333:trail/ciam-prod): its policy isn't rendered: the bucket exists already (ciamProviderRef)
how: Add these statements to bucket example-aero-ciam-prod-cloudtrail's policy: [{"Sid":"AWSCloudTrailAclCheck","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"s3:GetBucketAcl","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::example-aero-ciam-prod-cloudtrail","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceArn":"arn:aws:cloudtrail:us-east-1:111122223333:trail/ciam-prod"}}},{"Sid":"AWSCloudTrailWrite","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::example-aero-ciam-prod-cloudtrail/AWSLogs/111122223333/*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceArn":"arn:aws:cloudtrail:us-east-1:111122223333:trail/ciam-prod","s3:x-amz-acl":"bucket-owner-full-control"}}}]
Then apply the trail: CloudTrail checks the bucket's policy when the trail is created

notes.subject: asg-pf-engine
notes.text: exists: applying gives it launch template ciam-prod-pf-engine, which its instances run when they are next replaced
how: After applying, start an instance refresh on autoscaling group ciam-prod-pf-engine so its instances run the new template

notes.subject: Shield Advanced
notes.text: its protections need the account's subscription
how: Before applying, make sure the account subscribes to AWS Shield Advanced (a paid subscription with a one-year commitment): the protections fail without it

notes.subject: guardduty's findings to security-findings
notes.text: its resource policy must let events.amazonaws.com deliver to it
how: Allow events.amazonaws.com sns:Publish in topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111122223333:ciam-prod-security's access policy (aws:SourceArn the rule's ARN)

notes.subject: egress firewall `egress-firewall`
notes.text: reference this rule group from its firewall policy (arn:aws:network-firewall:us-east-1:111122223333:firewall-policy/ciam-prod-egress) (stateful_rule_group_reference)
how: After applying, add the rule group to the firewall policy's stateful rule group references (whoever keeps the policy)

notes.subject: egress firewall `egress-firewall`
notes.text: a domain list matches TLS SNI and HTTP Host only: email-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:587 isn't web traffic, so the policy's other stateful rules decide it
how: Allow email-smtp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:587 in the firewall policy's other stateful rules

notes.subject: flow log `flow-vpc`
notes.text: kept 30 days, the retention of ops-logs (not set here)
how: Set the retention of ops-logs to 30 days where it is kept
